convert_eqv2_to_hydra: run the eqv2_to_hydra_eqv2 script to convert an EquiformerV2 checkpoint and yaml config to Hydra format
convert_checkpoint_and_config: run the script with --eqv2-checkpoint and --eqv2-yaml to convert checkpoint and config to Hydra format
output_hydra_checkpoint: run the script with --hydra-eqv2-checkpoint to specify the output path for the converted Hydra checkpoint
output_hydra_yaml: run the script with --hydra-eqv2-yaml to specify the output path for the converted Hydra yaml config
run_eqv2_conversion_cli: run the eqv2_to_hydra_eqv2 CLI module with all four required arguments to perform the full conversion
